appearance_facts.location: line series, City A total population
appearance_facts.fact: A single blue line rises from the left edge to the right edge across the 2010-2015 span.
The line begins at the 2,000 gridline on the y-axis.
The line ends at the 3,000 gridline on the y-axis.
The line passes through approximately 2,200 (2011), 2,400 (2012), 2,600 (2013), and 2,800 (2014), showing a steady upward slope.
The title text reads 'Shrinking Population of City A from 2010 to 2015', which visually contradicts the upward-sloping line.
The plotted line indicates population increased by 1,000 over the period, not decreased.

printed_facts.fact: 'Shrinking Population of City A from 2010 to 2015'.
No individual point labels or data value annotations are printed on the line.

public_definitions: Goal: Review the City A population dashboard for 2010-2015, then choose the follow-up route for the population planning workflow.

uncertain: The chart title states 'Shrinking Population' while the plotted line clearly shows growth from 2,000 to 3,000; the source of the discrepancy (title error vs. data error) is not specified.
No explicit routing rule is provided that maps a specific trend direction to one of the three options.
